name: How long does it take to install a new sliding glass door?
description: Installation typically takes one day for standard replacements, but custom work or structural changes may require more time.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding glass door installation can vary based on factors like the door's size, the complexity of the opening, and whether any structural modifications are needed. A standard replacement often takes a single day. However, custom installations or those requiring frame adjustments may extend the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after our initial assessment, which helps you understand the commitment and preparation needed for a smooth installation.
